author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: सर्वात्मना नाशाभावादेवाव्यक्तो भगवानक्षर इत्युक्तः "तस्मादक्षरं तस्मादक्षरं" इति श्रुत्यादौ तां परमां गतिमाहुः ।  तामिति विधेयापेक्षया स्त्रीलिङ्गता ।  कुतोऽव्यक्तो भगवान्परमप्राप्य इत्यत आह ॥  यं प्राप्येति ।  तन्मम धाम स्वरूपमित्यर्थः ॥  ८.२१॥
translation:
The Unmanifest is therefore) called the Akshara (the Imperishable). They declare it the highest goal; (for), those who reach it return not. That is My Supreme. essence (nature). (21)
A. It has been stated that Bhakti and Yoga are chief steps, but it might seem that Bhakti is on a par with the other steps. To slow Bhakti to be far superior to all other steps Sri Krishna says:
